intended_object: The canonical bijection between the product ∏ᵢ Aᵢ and the set of unordered n-tuples having one point in each Aᵢ, for a pairwise disjoint family (A_i). For Heegaard diagrams this identifies T_α ⊆ Sym^g(Σ) with α₁ × ⋯ × α_g. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The map sends x to ofFn (fun i => (x i : α)). Injectivity uses the pairwise disjointness hypothesis, which is genuinely necessary: if A 0 = A 1 = {a, b}, the ordered pairs (a, b) and (b, a) give the same unordered tuple. Surjectivity holds because `pi A` is defined as the range of exactly this map. So the definition is the canonical bijection the docstring describes. It works for any type α. Indexing by Fin n is forced because Sym α n is indexed by a natural number. Mathlib has no general version of this bijection.
